category_title: Young adults with intellectual disabilities who exhibit passive agreement and chronic lateness
minimal_context: The tutor and student are reviewing a table of daily events during a one-on-one interview to discuss the student's routine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this table of your daily events. First, let's talk about getting lunch at 11:00 AM. The notes say you spend time trying to cut into line.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I sit by myself so I do not get in trouble.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Let's look at the morning transition. The hall teachers say you go into the restroom and do not come out until prompted.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Too far to next bell; I get late.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What about how you walk to this classroom? The notes say you take the staircase closest to our classroom, which requires you to walk all the way down the hall twice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Going a way I like to go by the windows or something.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at this table of your daily events. First, let's talk about getting lunch at 11:00 AM. The notes say you spend time trying to cut into line.

STUDENT: I sit by myself so I do not get in trouble.

TUTOR: Okay. Let's look at the morning transition. The hall teachers say you go into the restroom and do not come out until prompted.

STUDENT: Too far to next bell; I get late.

TUTOR: What about how you walk to this classroom? The notes say you take the staircase closest to our classroom, which requires you to walk all the way down the hall twice.

STUDENT: Going a way I like to go by the windows or something.
